title: Final Temperature Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly apply the Stefan-Boltzmann law to find the maximum temperature of the water as T = 341 K.

title: Effect of Absorptance Change
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the new maximum temperature when absorptance is halved, resulting in T' = 286 K.

title: Correct Use of Constants
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and use the value of the Stefan-Boltzmann constant, σ = 5.67 x 10^-8 W/m^2K^4.

title: Proportionality Understanding
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the relationship T ∝ α^(1/4) when discussing the effect of absorptance on temperature.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations, particularly in energy flux and temperature.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect signs or factors when applying the Stefan-Boltzmann law.

title: Absorptance Value
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not mistakenly use an incorrect value for absorptance in calculations.
